captions.detailed: A pop-up vehicle sunroof cassette assembly consisting of a flat, rectangular black frame, a main tinted glass panel, and a rear sliding section. The semi-transparent glass panel is hinged at its front edge to tilt upward via a revolute joint, while the rear section slides back and forth along a prismatic joint to control ventilation.
captions.instruction: Generate a pop-up sunroof cassette assembly with a flat outer frame, a main glass panel that hinges upwards at the front, and a rear section that slides horizontally. Apply a black plastic material to the frame and a semi-transparent glass material to the main panel.
captions.factory: The code defines an articulated model representing a sunroof assembly. It uses a base class architecture to construct three main parts: a fixed outer cassette frame, a tilting glass panel, and a sliding rear section. The geometry is generated using CadQuery's solid primitive construction (such as makeBox) wrapped inside visual representations. A revolute joint is declared at the front edge of the frame to articulate the glass panel, and a prismatic joint is declared along the longitudinal axis to articulate the sliding section.
